verdict.rationale: Trivy outputs results in open, standard formats (SBOM as CycloneDX/SPDX, JSON reports) and is open-source, self-hosted, so users are never locked into a vendor platform. However, 'export all data and leave' is a weaker fit for a stateless scanner rather than a data-storing SaaS — there's no persistent user data corpus to export beyond scan results/config. missing for 10: explicit data-portability/export documentation beyond SBOM/report formats, evidence of exporting scan history/state, and any migration/leave-the-platform guidance.
